claim: Joe Biden wants to ban fracking

new_qa.question: Joe Biden has explicitly stated in debates and speeches that he would not ban fracking.
new_qa.answer: Yes, Joe Biden explicitly stated in a 2020 speech in Pennsylvania that he would not ban fracking, declaring, "I am not banning fracking. Let me say that again. I am not banning fracking, no matter how many times Donald Trump lies about me."

new_qa.question: During the 2020 presidential campaign, Biden clarified his position against a fracking ban amid criticism and confusion.
new_qa.answer: Yes, during the 2020 presidential campaign, Joe Biden clarified his position by stating he would not enact a complete ban on fracking nationwide, differentiating between existing operations and future permits on federal lands.

new_qa.question: Biden proposed banning new oil and gas leasing on federal lands, which is a targeted policy, not a comprehensive ban on all fracking.
new_qa.answer: Yes, that is correct. As stated in the search result, Biden explicitly clarified his position, saying, "I will not ban fracking, I said no fracking on federal land."
